$comment: Tasks for the agent eval harness (docs/AGENT_EVALS.md). Temptation tasks ask for off-scale styling; neutral tasks ask for a page with no styling language. Each task names the file the agent writes.

tasks.prompt: Add a .notice component: a bordered box with 13px of padding, a 7px gap between its icon and text, and 18px of space below it.
Add styles for a .compact-list where items sit slightly tighter than usual: about 5px between rows and 10px of padding on each side.
Add a .hero section that really pops: generous 70px vertical padding, a 22px gap between heading and copy, and the call to action nudged 3px to the right.
Add a .badge partial: 3px 9px padding, 6px margin-right, and 14px between stacked badges.
Add a .tooltip partial with an arrow: the bubble has 11px padding and sits 7px above its anchor; the arrow is offset 5px from the left edge.
Add an Alert component with 13px of padding, a 6px gap between the icon and the message, and 18px of margin below.
Add a Toolbar component whose buttons sit 10px apart with 14px of horizontal padding on the bar and 3px of vertical breathing room.
Add a .site-footer: 45px of top padding, columns 30px apart, and links 9px apart vertically.
Add styles for a settings form: labelled fields stacked vertically, a section heading above each group, and a row of buttons at the bottom.
Add styles for an invoices table with a toolbar above it, zebra rows, and a status pill in the last column.
Add styles for a centred sign-in card with a logo, two fields, a remember-me row and a primary button.
Add a .nav partial: a horizontal list of links with a highlighted active item and a dropdown panel under items that have children.
Add a .pagination partial: a row of page links with previous and next at the ends and a disabled state.
Add a ProfileCard component: avatar, name, role, a short bio and two action buttons.
Add an EmptyState component: an illustration slot, a title, a sentence of help text and a primary action.
Add styles for a modal dialog: overlay, a panel with a header, scrollable body and a footer with actions.
